### Description ProContract is a cloud-based e-tendering and contract lifecycle management platform widely used across the UK public and third sectors. It provides a single digital environment where buying organisations advertise contract opportunities and suppliers submit bids. More than 400 organisations—including local authorities, NHS trusts, housing associations, emergency services, and universities—use ProContract to manage quotes and formal tenders. Beyond the central portal (procontract.due-north.com), the software serves as the underlying engine for major UK regional portals allowing suppliers to access opportunities across dozens of authorities with one registration.
### Core Capabilities for Suppliers 1. Free Registration & Alerts: Suppliers create an account at no cost, select relevant service categories and geographic regions, and receive automated daily email alerts when matching tenders or requests for quotation (RFQs) go live. 2. Digital Bid Management: Once registered, suppliers can express interest in an opportunity, download specification documents, and upload tender responses electronically before a strict countdown deadline. 3. Clarification Messaging: All bidder questions are submitted through an in-portal messaging system; buyers typically publish anonymised answers to all interested suppliers to maintain fairness and transparency. 4. Frameworks & Dynamic Purchasing Systems (DPS): Supports applications to multi-supplier frameworks and open DPS arrangements that accept new providers over multi-year periods.
### Core Capabilities for Buyers 1. End-to-End Sourcing Workflow: Automates the procurement process from preliminary market engagement and tender publication through to sealed-bid opening, evaluation, and contract award. 2. Statutory Notice Integration: Connects directly with UK public procurement portals (such as Find a Tender) so contracting authorities can publish compliant notices without duplicate data entry. 3. Auditability & Contract Registers: Maintains a complete, time-stamped audit trail of all communications and hosts public contract registers detailing active agreements, contract values, and upcoming renewal or re-tender dates.
### ProContract vs. Proactis Supplier Network Because Proactis acquired Due North, UK suppliers occasionally confuse ProContract with the separate Proactis Supplier Network (proactishosting.com). While both are owned by Proactis and used by UK councils and NHS bodies, they operate on different infrastructure and require separate supplier logins.
ProContract is optimized for the Dynamics 365 platform. Owned by Commercial
